limitations.quote: The final 0 and current 1 start an overlapping match
limitations.note: The agent correctly preserved `s3_d011` across invalid cycles, but also changed the transitions after a completed match to reuse its final zero, enabling overlapping matches that the original and reference implementations did not report.
The exhaustive test used a sliding window that expected overlapping matches, so it confirmed the agent’s new behavior instead of checking that post-match behavior stayed unchanged.
